text: Netflix reported its fourth-quarter 2025 earnings and held its earnings call on January 20. Although sales exceeded Wall Street's target and subscribers surpassed 325 million alongside a Warner Bros. acquisition announcement, management acknowledged that increased content spending and integration costs could pressure margins.
